fields.name: isBook
fields.description: Explicit flag driving portrait reuse/persist-vs-delete behavior in scene image generation. Replaces inferring book-vs-fallback intent from scene group path text.

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: The book's COMMON image config (style + composition + generation params). One config drives portraits, landscape, and scene; style comes from getSDConfigPrompt(sdConfig).

fields.name: compositeSdConfig
fields.description: Optional ALTERNATE config for the composite/Kontext step only (a different pipeline/model). Falls back to sdConfig when absent.

fields.name: sdConfigOverride
fields.description: Optional SPARSE per-scene override (a delta) merged onto the common sdConfig via SDUtil.applyOverrides for this one scene.

fields.name: sceneObjectIds
fields.description: Scene objectIds for POST /{bookObjectId}/prepare-images — batch-resolve landscape prompts before any SD calls.
